title: Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Prototype-Based Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2605.26857v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Driven by the pressing demand for graph anomaly detection (GAD) in high-stakes domains, the generalist GAD paradigm, which trains a single detector transferable across new graphs, has recently gained growing attention. However, existing methods often rely on scarce and costly annotations for training and sometimes even require few-shot support at inference, which limits their robustness to diverse and unseen anomaly patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce ProMoS, the first unsupervised generalist GAD framework, which detects anomalies by modeling the abundant normality in unlabeled data. ProMoS adopts a knowledge-distillation paradigm to distill normality priors from a frozen self-supervised graph neural network (GNN) teacher to a mixture-of-students model with shared global and lightweight personalized branches, enabling efficient and expressive normality modeling without learning from scratch. translated_title: 基于原型蒸馏的通用图异常检测
translated_abstract: 在高风险领域对图异常检测（GAD）的迫切需求推动下，通用GAD范式——即训练一个可迁移至新图的单一检测器——近期受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有方法通常依赖稀缺且昂贵的标注进行训练，有时甚至在推理时还需要少样本支持，这限制了它们对多样化和未见异常模式的鲁棒性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了ProMoS，首个无监督的通用图异常检测框架，它通过建模无标签数据中丰富的正常模式来检测异常。ProMoS采用知识蒸馏范式，将正常性先验从冻结的自监督图神经网络（GNN）教师模型蒸馏到具有共享全局分支和轻量级个性化分支的学生混合模型中，无需从头学习即可实现高效且富有表现力的正常性建模。我们进一步提出了原型……（摘要在此处被截断，后续内容不完整）
tldr: 提出了首个无监督通用图异常检测框架ProMoS，通过知识蒸馏将冻结自监督GNN教师模型的正常性先验迁移到混合学生模型中，利用基于原型的建模在无标签数据上检测异常。
en_tdlr: ProMoS is the first unsupervised generalist graph anomaly detection framework that distills normality priors from a frozen self-supervised GNN teacher into a mixture-of-students model, detecting anomalies by modeling abundant normality in unlabeled data without requiring costly annotations.
